text: She's fifteen now. She can't get up on her own anymore, she's stopped eating since Tuesday, and she's had accidents in the house.

text: With her kidney disease getting worse, and her not eating and not able to stand, her quality of life has really declined.

text: We think it's time. We've talked about it as a family and we're ready.

text: Okay. I'll need you to sign the consent form, and then we can take our time.

text: First I'll give her a sedative so she's relaxed. Dexmedetomidine and butorphanol, into the muscle.

text: She's very relaxed now. Now the euthanasia solution, pentobarbital, six mils IV, through the catheter.

text: I'm listening to her heart. There's no heartbeat. She passed at three forty.

text: We'd like her cremated privately, and could we have a paw print?
